Entry Social Hierarchy of the Wall and Free Folk The social hierarchy within and beyond the Great Wall is never just written on family trees. Night's Watch maintains order by discipline and shared burdens, while free folk build relationships through tribes, campfires, and personal choice; neither can despise winter; the same order may seem natural in the hall. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.
